layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of a volcanic lake region
features: A cluster of interconnected clear lakes
Sloping hills covered in Ginkgo and Araucaria groves
Ground blanketed in bright green liverworts and mosses
Distant jagged volcanic peaks under a clear blue sky
Visible layers of grey volcanic ash in the soil banks
layer_3_action.action: A wide, bright landscape showing the diversity of a volcanic lake district at noon. The ground is a lush, non-grass carpet of ancient spore-plants.

visuals.ground: Nutrient-rich dark soil with visible ash layers, completely covered in a sponge of green moss and low-lying ferns. No grass.
visuals.water: Sparkling blue lake water with clear, shallow edges showing submerged volcanic stones.
visuals.sky: Bright, saturated blue with high-noon clarity and thin, wispy clouds.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Soft mosses punctuated by the geometric patterns of horsetails and the rough texture of volcanic pumice.

negative_prompt: grass, lawn, prairie, dark shadows, gloom, sunset, scary, 90s CGI, grainy, humans
